links.comparator_used: Whisper ASR transcription without a contextual system message
links.outcome: Character error rate of mixed Chinese-English pathology dictation transcription
links.effect: Mean character error rate fell from 0.344 (SD 0.176; 95% CI 0.313-0.375) to 0.066 (SD 0.100; 95% CI 0.048-0.084); P<.001
